audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-12 CLOSURE ROUND - the pure flip, no new ink. The issue-12 part-two box (the Persian Mythos and the Lovecraftian Mythos, folios 8-11 and 18-21) closes 2 closed / 0 open in tools/dragon_gap_report_012.md; the four-chain walk completes exactly as adjudicated - the R919 part-one pair (the Ovalle illusionist article and the Endersby and Carroll ship cargo article) and the R920 part-two pair (the Arkenberg Persian Mythos and the Kuntz/Holmes Lovecraftian Mythos). The bookkeeping pins: the two boxes and their four chains, the issue-11 report complete at 1 / 0 since R918, the issue-10 report complete at 2 / 0 since R916, the issue-9 report complete at 1 / 0 since R913, the issue-8 report complete at 1 / 0 since R911, the issue-7 report complete at 1 / 0 since R909, the issue-6 report complete at 1 / 0 since R907, and the registry ground truth carried forward. Per the Curtiss call this round ends the issue-12 walk with NO issue-13 opener to follow.

banner.provenance: Bookkeeping only, no new ink pinned. The issue-12 walk (R919 opener part one, R920 opener part two, this flip) covered The Dragon Vol. II No. 6 (February 1978), the archive.org scan voice, single-voice - no chat-side upload cross-check exists for issue 12; the source lives in the archive.org item accessory-dragon-magazine-012. Per the Curtiss call: no issue-13 opener follows - the walk ends here, the Name That Monster winners and the brawling long-term-effects sequel left unharvested for now.
banner.sentinel: The R919 and R920 sentinel pins ride unchanged - the cargo grid’s three blank/count cells, the illusionist ladder garbles, the Atar bar garbles, the Vayu move fraction, the five hero strength fraction garbles and the god-grid see-below and resistance cells all ride the -1 sentinel as pinned - this round touches no ink.
